lease_text: The security deposit is non-refundable and shall be retained by the landlord in full upon move-out regardless of the condition of the unit.
The landlord may enter the premises at any time without notice and for any reason at the landlord's sole discretion.
If the tenant reports any condition to the Board of Health, the landlord may terminate this tenancy and evict the tenant.
The tenant hereby waives the implied warranty of habitability and all statutory rights and remedies under Massachusetts law.
Upon nonpayment of rent the landlord may change the locks and remove the tenant's belongings without going to court.
The tenant may be evicted immediately for nonpayment of rent without any written notice to quit.
The landlord shall have no obligation to make any repairs to the premises during the tenancy.
The tenant agrees to pay a nonrefundable move-in fee of $500 in addition to the security deposit and last month's rent.
